patterns.note: Full-bleed hero sections, often with video or photography, establish a strong visual presence, followed by a structured grid system for content and feature displays.
Headings use a large, bold sans-serif font for impact, while body text is a highly readable, slightly lighter sans-serif, maintaining a clear hierarchy. Some labels are set in uppercase.
A high-contrast palette of white, dark grey/black, and a vibrant accent blue is used consistently, with the blue reserved for interactive elements, icons, and key brand highlights.
The header navigation transitions from transparent over the hero to an opaque white background with a subtle shadow and slight height reduction as the user scrolls down the page.
Content is organized into distinct, well-spaced sections, often featuring icon-based cards for services, image-text blocks for features, and news/article previews, all within a consistent grid.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a full-bleed video background with a subtle dark overlay to ensure text readability, presenting key messages and calls to action prominently over the dynamic visual.

A sticky header navigation is implemented, which dynamically changes its background from transparent to solid white and slightly reduces its height upon scroll, providing persistent access while optimizing screen space.

Content sections are structured using flexible grid layouts, allowing for responsive arrangement of feature cards, image-text pairs, and news items, ensuring visual balance across different screen sizes.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) create strong visual anchors, complemented by clear, readable body text and smaller, often uppercase, informational labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (e.g., buttons, card corners), maintaining a clean and modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a more compact rhythm within content cards and lists.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its sophisticated use of full-bleed, high-quality video heroes that immediately convey a sense of global reach and modern relevance. This is paired with a meticulously clean and authoritative layout, where a vibrant accent blue is strategically deployed against a largely monochrome palette, reinforcing brand trust and guiding user attention without visual clutter.
